title: StateInner is held for seconds on an idle host: every commit_locked builds the full 19.3 MB, 6,793-session snapshot under the lock and the writer's tail trim runs under it too, starving the persistence writer (missed fences, withheld turns) and API readers (Greg P0, 2026-10-22)
outcome: General commits capture immutable snapshot inputs for deferred publication, avoiding repeated full session-summary projection under StateInner while preserving snapshot/delta ordering, exact commit cuts, cache validation and shutdown drain. The live idle-host writer-wait and admission outcome formerly stated here is preserved in w-7bc33299e17a and remains unproved until that linked item's post-restart observation passes.
acceptance: A measurement note records the observed multi-second StateInner waits on the idle 6,793-session host and identifies the source paths for full-snapshot construction and writer tail trimming. It distinguishes measured waits from source-inferred causes and states explicitly that exclusive holder shares are unmeasured: no existing acquisition-site diagnostics were supplied, and a new capture is not authorized.

Tests show that a general commit no longer builds the full snapshot under the state lock, with the cross-referenced items w-919a18aecf19 and w-b17b985f5dbc either consumed or left with their remaining scope stated. The original C2 live clause is preserved verbatim in linked item w-7bc33299e17a; that item's post-restart measurements and turn_begin proof remain open and are not claimed by this source item.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact committed tree with an independent review pair and no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.

completion.summary: Landed deferred snapshot publication and warm queue-identity validation in bf7ff309; exact registered closure check PASS6 and received verification recorded. Historical measured waits remain distinguished from inferred causes; post-restart live proof remains open in the linked item. No acceptance evaluation exists.
